message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I was caught off guard. I fumbled around in the dark for a flashlight, only to find out the batteries were dead. I ended up using my phone light to guide me to my stash of snacks—because who wants to be hungry in the dark? It reminded me that even if I’m not fully prepared, I can always find a way to make the best of a situation. Have you ever had a funny moment during a power outage?
